limitations: Manifest has face-presence labels, not person bounding-box GT. Face-positive-frame coverage is a PROXY only, not person recall/precision/mAP/localization.
Adjacent frames are not independent subjects/samples; synthetic diagnostic only.
No production threshold selected or changed.

environment.peak_rss_note: macOS ru_maxrss bytes; Linux ru_maxrss KiB*1024; best-effort process peak, includes test/runtime overhead.
